title: 3D Carpenter's Square – Angle Ruler with Scriber
descriptionHtml:
Stop guessing – measure and mark the right angle every time

Crooked cuts, wrong angles and measurements that don't add up are what turn a fun building project into frustration and wasted material. Fumbling with several different rulers and protractors doesn't make it easier.

All the angles in a single tool

This 3D carpenter's square lets you mark 22.5°, 45° and 90° quickly and precisely – perfect for trim, shelves, boxes and everything that needs to fit together in corners. The built-in scriber lets you draw a clear line right away, without searching for the pencil.

Features

  • Measures and marks 22.5°, 45° and 90° in one and the same tool
  • Built-in scriber for clear markings
  • Compact and light – fits in the toolbox or your pocket
  • Ideal for carpenters, craftsmen and DIYers
  • Durable material that withstands daily use

14 days to change your mind. Counted from the day you receive the item.
